detail_text: Specifically, Your firm did not perform adequate cleaning validation on Tanks [redacted] and [redacted] which are used in the production of multiple drug products including Lidocaine and Dexmedetomidine HCL Injection. Lidocaine was discovered as a contaminant in lots 7067815, 7069770, 7069771, 6121853 and 6122207 of Dexmedetomidine HCL when an OOT investigation identified an unknown impurity HPLC peak as Lidocaine. The unknown impurity was found in 5 of the [redacted] lots of Dexmedetomidine produced at this site. For each affected lot of Dexmedetomidine HCL, Lidocaine was the previously manufactured product in the tanks. All affected lots of Dexmedetomidine HCL Injections were released and distributed.

detail_text: Specifically, A) Pressure differentials between areas with different air classifications (ISO 6 cleanroom and ISO 7 anteroom) are not routinely monitored/documented prior or during sterile drug production. A review of the firm's compounding records noted that the firm does not routinely document pressure differentials. B) Pressure differentials are measured with wall-mounted manometers which are not visible from within the cleanroom. For example, I observed the firm performing sterile compounding on 03/05/2020 and I observed that the differential pressure gauge readings between the cleanroom and the anteroom were not within acceptable ranges. The cleanroom reading was.015 and the anteroom reading was.025. The firm was processing patient specific sterile drug products which included Morphine Sulfate 7.5 mg/ml and Morphine Sulfate 12 mg/mJ both with a BUD of 03/05/2020 and for intrathecal administration.
detail_text_ko: 구체적으로, A) 공기 등급이 다른 구역(ISO 6 cleanroom과 ISO 7 anteroom) 사이의 차압은 무균 의약품 생산 전이나 생산 중에 정기적으로 모니터링/문서화되지 않는다. 귀사의 조제 기록을 검토한 결과, 귀사는 차압을 정기적으로 문서화하지 않는 것으로 확인되었다. B) 차압은 벽걸이형 마노미터로 측정되는데, 이는 cleanroom 내부에서 보이지 않는다. 예를 들어, 03/05/2020에 실사관은 귀사의 무균 조제 작업을 관찰했으며 cleanroom과 anteroom 사이의 차압계 판독값이 허용 범위 내에 있지 않은 것을 관찰했다. cleanroom 판독값은 .015였고 anteroom 판독값은 .025였다. 당시 귀사는 모두 BUD가 03/05/2020이고 척수강 내 투여용인 Morphine Sulfate 7.5 mg/ml 및 Morphine Sulfate 12 mg/mJ을 포함한 환자별 무균 의약품을 처리하고 있었다.
